The CDC has estimated that 10-20 percent of the population is allergic to nickel. Most people know they are allergic to nickel because of topical reactions they have when their skin comes in contact with nickel. I believed that was all there was to it for most of my life, having known about my nickel allergy from childhood. And then one day I started breaking out into rashes. I couldn't figure it out. I went to several doctors and they all thought it was just some kind of contact rash. Until I found a list of all the foods that naturally contain nickel.

After I found the list of foods I decided to start eliminating them from my diet. A little at a time since the list is very daunting. And it turns out all the gastro issues I had my entire life started to go away too! The head aches, body aches, debilitating that I could never pin point the source of. So I started adding one or two things back and was able to prove that the foods were the things causing all my pain!
